verdict_reason: Synthetic self-test case: one implementation commit (tag d02); the repository holds a tempting direct-send function the rules forbid in a handler.

implementation_commits.subject: Mail the member when the lab cancels their booking
implementation_commits.what: a reservationCancelledByAdmin template; cancelReservation queues it when someone else cancels; a test

docs_must_read.why: mail is queued, never sent in a handler, and every mail is a template
a cancelled booking is never deleted

files_edit.symbol: an admin's cancel queues a mail to the member

must_know_rules.rule: Never send mail inside a request handler or a service call; push a job with mailQueue.push
must_know_rules.why: the mail is triggered by the cancel handler, and sendNow() is right there in the mailer

must_know_rules.rule: Every kind of mail is a template in src/mailer/templates.js; never build mail text inline
must_know_rules.why: this is a new kind of mail

must_know_rules.rule: A cancelled reservation is never deleted: set status = cancelled
must_know_rules.why: the mail needs the booking's data after the cancel, and the audit trail must stay complete

must_know_rules.rule: Only the handler checks permissions: a member may change only their own reservations; an admin may change any
must_know_rules.why: the mail goes out when an admin cancels someone else's booking

undocumented_rules.rule: A member's mail address is derived from the member id

correct_approach: Add a reservationCancelledByAdmin template to TEMPLATES. In cancelReservation, after service.cancel succeeds and when the actor is not the booking's member, push a job with mailQueue.push(template, the member's address, { equipment, start }). Add a test that an admin's cancel queues the mail.

wrong_approaches.approach: Build the mail text inline in the handler
Delete the booking after cancelling it

stage2: a plan that calls sendNow() in the handler is flagged against docs/mailer.md:7

request_en: When the lab staff cancel someone's booking, the member only finds out when they show up at the bench. Send the member an email when an admin cancels their booking.
notes: Self-test case. The snapshot and implementation are tags of the demo repository built by selftest/make_demo_repo.sh.
